calls.title: GB x Angel - Pricing Discussion
calls.summary: The discussion centered around securing a competitive enterprise upgrade deal for the client, priced just under $95,000 annually, which includes unlimited seats and enterprise features. Cary Rakin emphasized the importance of a multi-year commitment to stabilize costs while ensuring pricing aligns with the client’s expectations. The client, experiencing volatile growth with around 400 employees and a subscriber base nearing 3 million, is cautious about seat increases but expects higher experiment volumes. Approval is contingent on the head of engineering's return on the 24th, with expected executive signoff shortly thereafter. The client maintains a preference for self-hosting solutions but is open to cloud options that reduce costs or complexity. The vendor values collaboration and transparency, reinforcing the significance of client feedback.
calls.keywords: pricing negotiation, enterprise upgrade, self-hosting, unlimited seats, user tracking, data analytics
